{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid ion striker''' was a basic charged ion weapon primarily employed by [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] to disable and destroy other droids, no matter whether they were identified as [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassins]], enemies or simply malfunctioning.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
